the liver has a large number of exchangeable pools, which are distributed in the intercellular space, the cells themselves, and the sinusoidal endothelial cells.
the liver is an open system, with the cellular barrier the most important site of exchange, and with the interstitial space a major site of storage.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the liver is a very dynamic organ, with a high degree of cellular exchange and a high degree of intracellular metabolism.
the liver, like other organs, is composed of a complex system of intercommunicating compartments.
